search_recipes.name: Search recipes
search_recipes.description: Find compact recipe candidates by words in any order, with minor typo tolerance. Returns recipes (id, name, score, match_explanation), count and has_more. Scores rank relevance, not confidence. Use conversation context to select a candidate, clarify ambiguous matches before editing, then call get_recipe with its exact ID for full details.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Specific AnyList config entry to query when multiple AnyList accounts are configured. Use the same entry for get_recipe.

query.name: Query
query.description: Recipe search words. Must contain at least one letter or number. Case, punctuation, accents and word order are normalized; extra title words are allowed.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum candidates to return (1 to 50). Defaults to 15. Unrelated recipes are excluded even if fewer candidates remain.

include_ingredients.name: Search ingredient names
include_ingredients.description: Also match ingredient names, with less weight than titles. Ingredients and preparation steps are never included in search results.

get_recipes.name: Get recipes
get_recipes.description: Return AnyList recipes with an optional case-insensitive substring filter. For ranked word and typo matching, use search_recipes, then get_recipe with a selected ID.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Specific AnyList config entry to query when multiple AnyList accounts are configured.

query.name: Query
query.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied to recipe names.

include_ingredients.name: Include ingredients
include_ingredients.description: Include ingredients in each returned recipe.

include_steps.name: Include preparation steps
include_steps.description: Include preparation steps in each returned recipe.

get_recipe.name: Get recipe
get_recipe.description: Return a single AnyList recipe by ID or exact name. After search_recipes, pass the selected candidate's exact ID as recipe_id to retrieve full details. Clarify ambiguous matches before editing.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry ID
config_entry_id.description: Specific AnyList config entry to query when multiple AnyList accounts are configured.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: Unique AnyList recipe ID. Provide either this or name.

name.name: Name
name.description: Exact AnyList recipe name. Provide either this or recipe_id.

include_ingredients.name: Include ingredients
include_ingredients.description: Include ingredients in the returned recipe.

include_steps.name: Include preparation steps
include_steps.description: Include preparation steps in the returned recipe.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Add an item or reuse a matching checked item. A supplied category overrides its previous category. Omitted quantity, notes, and category assignments are preserved on reused items.

name.name: Name
name.description: Item name without quantity or notes. A checked item with the same name is reused, ignoring case.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: Quantity text, such as 2 or 2 kg. Omit to preserve a reused item's quantity. Use an empty string to clear it.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Item notes. Omit to preserve a reused item's notes. Use an empty string to clear them.

category.name: Category
category.description: Existing category name or match ID. Overrides known categorization, including on reused checked items. Invalid or ambiguous selections reject the action. Provide either this or category_id.

category_id.name: Category ID
category_id.description: Exact category ID from get_categories, as an alternative to a category name.

category_set_id.name: Category set ID
category_set_id.description: Optional exact set ID from get_categories. Use it to distinguish matching names in different sets.

update_item.name: Update item
update_item.description: Change quantity, notes, or a category assignment without changing the item's name or checked state. Omitted fields and assignments in other category sets are preserved. Supply at least one field.

item.name: Item
item.description: Item UID from todo.get_items, or an exact, case-sensitive item name. Use a UID if names are duplicated.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: New quantity text. Omit to keep the current value. Use an empty string to clear it.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: New notes. Omit to keep the current value. Use an empty string to clear them.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category name or match ID for an explicit move. Unknown or ambiguous categories reject the entire action. Provide either this or category_id.

category_id.name: Category ID
category_id.description: Exact category ID from get_categories, as an alternative to a category name.

category_set_id.name: Category set ID
category_set_id.description: Optional exact set ID from get_categories. Use it to distinguish matching names in different sets.

get_categories.name: Get categories
get_categories.description: Return category names, IDs, and category sets for each targeted AnyList to-do entity, including empty categories. Refresh before reading and optionally include item counts per category.

category_set_id.name: Category set ID
category_set_id.description: Optional exact set ID to return only that set's categories.

include_counts.name: Include item counts
include_counts.description: Include needs_action_count, completed_count, and total_count for each category. Counts are independent for each set.

create_category.name: Create category
create_category.description: Create a custom category and optionally return its ID and metadata. Reject duplicate names within the selected set. Does not create items or change the default category.

name.name: Name
name.description: Non-empty name for the new category. Names ignore case and extra whitespace when checking for duplicates within the set.

category_set_id.name: Category set ID
category_set_id.description: Exact set ID from get_categories. Required when the list has multiple sets; otherwise the only set is used.
